summary: Inspected all six retained responsive captures and their current read-only geometry probes at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px. Fonts are ready at every width. The page reports zero horizontal overflow except 1 px at 375, but the dialog itself is clipped at three intermediate/desktop widths because its measured right edge exceeds the viewport.
issues: CHK-RESP-001 | priority: high | property: registration dialog viewport containment | expected: the complete dialog, fields, consent copy and controls remain inside each retained viewport | actual: measured dialog x/width/right are 730/802/1532 at 1440, 650/802/1452 at 1280, and 522/802/1324 at 1024, exceeding the viewport by 92, 172 and 300 px; screenshots visibly clip the right side | fix: constrain and reposition the desktop dialog against the viewport (or enter its fitting responsive layout earlier) without introducing document overflow.

CHK-RESP-002 | priority: low | property: narrow-screen horizontal overflow | expected: 0 px at 375 | actual: retained probe reports 1 px and the capture shows a thin right-edge strip | fix: remove the single overflowing pixel from the page-owned narrow layout.

CHK-RESP-003 | priority: high | property: responsive dialog control availability | expected: a visible, reachable close control at every retained width | actual: no close control is visible in any retained responsive capture | fix: expose the source-backed dialog close control within the visible bounds at every breakpoint.
